description: This Java source file defines the `TouchRotateActivity` class for an Android application. It demonstrates how to use `GLSurfaceView` for rendering OpenGL graphics, specifically implementing a touch-controlled rotating cube. The file contains activity lifecycle methods, a custom `GLSurfaceView` subclass with touch and trackball event handling, and a renderer class that draws and updates a 3D cube.

classes.name: TouchSurfaceView
classes.description: A custom GLSurfaceView handling touch and trackball events to rotate a 3D cube.

classes.name: TouchSurfaceView.CubeRenderer
classes.description: Renderer class that handles OpenGL rendering of a rotating cube, implementing the GLSurfaceView.Renderer interface.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the GLSurfaceView and the rendering mode.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles activity resume, resumes the GLSurfaceView rendering.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Handles activity pause, pauses the GLSurfaceView rendering.

methods.name: TouchSurfaceView
methods.description: Constructor initializing the custom GLSurfaceView and setting its renderer and mode.

methods.name: onTrackballEvent
methods.description: Handles trackball events to rotate the cube.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch events for user interaction to rotate the cube.

methods.name: onCapturedPointerEvent
methods.description: Handles pointer capture events, providing additional touch input handling.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key press events to possibly release pointer capture.

methods.name: updateAngles
methods.description: Updates the rotation angles of the cube based on user input.

methods.name: CubeRenderer
methods.description: Implements the Renderer interface; responsible for drawing and updating the cube scene.

methods.name: onDrawFrame
methods.description: Called to draw each frame; clears the buffer and draws the rotated cube.

methods.name: onSurfaceChanged
methods.description: Handles surface size changes, updates the viewport and projection matrix.

methods.name: onSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Initializes OpenGL state and sets up the rendering environment.
